items.title: Cannes Prize-Winning ‘Brink of Dreams’ Director Ayman El Amir Preps Dark Comedy About Egypt’s Obsession With ‘Fame at All Costs’ (EXCLUSIVE)
items.title_zh: 戛纳电影节获奖导演艾曼·埃尔·阿米尔（ Ayman El Amir ）准备黑色喜剧，讲述埃及对“不惜一切代价成名”的痴迷（独家）
items.summary: Egyptian filmmaker Ayman El Amir, who co-directed the groundbreaking, Cannes prize-winning documentary “The Brink of Dreams,” is developing his next feature, “A Pair of Shoes in the Dark Corner of the Moon.” The satirical comedy is among the projects that will be taking part in…
items.summary_zh: 埃及电影制片人艾曼·埃尔·阿米尔（ Ayman El Amir ）是戛纳获奖纪录片《梦的边缘》（ The Brink of Dreams ）的联合导演，他正在开发他的下一部纪录片《月球黑暗角落里的一双鞋》（ A Pair of Shoes in the Dark Corner of the Moon ）。“这部讽刺喜剧是将参与的项目之一……

items.title: Tate McRae and Doechii Choreographer Robbie Blue Among World Choreography Award Winners
items.title_zh: 泰特·麦克雷（ Tate McRae ）和Doechii编舞家罗比·布鲁（ Robbie Blue ）跻身世界编舞大奖
items.summary: Robbie Blue, the choreographer for pop and rap stars Tate McRae and Doechii, took home three World Choreography Awards at the 2026 ceremony. He and his associates were recognized for the intricate moves of McRae’s “Saturday Night Live” dance and Doechii’s electric 67th Grammys…
items.summary_zh: 流行和说唱明星Tate McRae和Doechii的编舞Robbie Blue在2026年的颁奖典礼上获得了三项世界编舞奖。他和他的同事因麦克雷的“周六夜现场”舞蹈和Doechii的第67届电动格莱美奖的复杂动作而得到认可……

items.title: Is Jensen Huang’s job on the line? Yale’s Jeffrey Sonnenfeld estimates it’s “about a 50-50”
items.title_zh: Jensen Huang的工作在线吗？耶鲁大学的杰弗里·索南菲尔德（ Jeffrey Sonnenfeld ）估计， “大约是50-50”
items.summary: Nvidia’s board is investigating Jensen Huang over his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and Yale’s Jeffrey Sonnenfeld thinks it’s roughly a coin flip whether Huang stays on as CEO.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达董事会正在调查Jensen Huang与中国间谍嫌疑人的关系，耶鲁大学的Jeffrey Sonnenfeld认为，无论Huang是否继续担任首席执行官，这大概是一个硬币翻转。

items.title: From supermarket fridges to passenger flights, a wave of threats is testing Europe's defenses
items.title_zh: 从超市冰箱到客运航班，一系列威胁正在考验欧洲的防御能力
items.summary: Cyberattacks on fridges in supermarkets and a wave of bomb threats are testing Europe’s ability to withstand disruption to crucial infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 对超市冰箱的网络攻击和一波炸弹威胁正在考验欧洲抵御关键基础设施中断的能力。

items.title: China wholesale inflation hits highest in more than four years as consumer measure slows
items.title_zh: 由于消费者措施放缓，中国批发通货膨胀率达到四年多来的最高水平
items.summary: The PPI for October came in at 5.7%, compared to the 5.3% expected by economists polled by Reuters.
items.summary_zh: 10月份的PPI为5.7% ，而路透社调查的经济学家预计为5.3%。

items.title: Here’s the full text of Jensen Huang’s memo to Nvidia
items.title_zh: 以下是Jensen Huang给Nvidia的备忘录全文
items.summary: On Sunday, Nvidia announced it was launching an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, an AI executive and agent of the Chinese government.
items.summary_zh: 周日，英伟达宣布将对首席执行官黄延森（ Jensen Huang ）与中国政府人工智能高管兼代理人黄爱丽丝（ Alice Huang ）的关系展开调查。

items.title: Soul Glo’s Diaspora Problems is a hardcore record like no other
items.title_zh: Soul Glo的Diaspora Problems是一张与众不同的硬核唱片
items.summary: Soul Glo has a new record called NA I'M GON GRAB ALLAT coming out in January, and I, for one, can not wait. While two singles have dropped, it's not enough to truly tide me over, so I've been revisiting Songs to Yeet at the Sun and my favorite album of 2022 - Diaspora Problems.
items.summary_zh: Soul Glo有一张名为NA I 'm GON GRAB ALLAT的新唱片将于1月发行，我迫不及待。虽然两首单曲已经下降，但还不足以让我真正渡过难关，所以我一直在重温《Songs to Yeet at the Sun》和我最喜欢的2022年专辑《Diaspora Problems》。

items.title: Apps to distract you from the endless cycle of doomscrolling
items.title_zh: 应用程序可以分散您对无休止的末日滚动周期的注意力
items.summary: It's hard to break the cycle of doomscrolling, but there are plenty of apps that can help you spend more time on content that’s engaging and productive.
items.summary_zh: 很难打破末日滚动的循环，但有很多应用程序可以帮助您将更多时间花在引人入胜且富有成效的内容上。

items.title: Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy
items.title_zh: 英伟达将调查首席执行官黄延森与可能的中国间谍的关系
items.summary: In a memo to the company, Huang admitted that he had an affair.
items.summary_zh: 在给公司的一份备忘录中，黄承认自己有外遇。

items.title: Epic Games Launcher is coming to SteamOS
items.summary: In October, Epic Games said that it was "investigating" making Fortnite compatible with Valve's Linux-based SteamOS. At the time, Epic Games Launcher was in preview, but SteamOS was not specifically listed as a supported distro.
items.summary_zh: 10月， Epic Games表示正在“调查”使Fortnite与Valve基于Linux的SteamOS兼容。当时， Epic Games Launcher处于预览状态，但SteamOS并未具体列为受支持的发行版。
